items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Joe Garland, he helped push it and them when I was on Cash Box--I mean Bandstand, he helped get them in. You see, I just went up there myself and Joe Garland helped get the men together.

ctx.x: Rene Players, Earl Palmer and you were partners?

Yeah. But the public appearance was me and that's how I made so much and then the next thing about it, Joe Garland, he helped push it and them when I was on Cash Box--I mean Bandstand, he helped get them in. You see, I just went up there myself and Joe Garland helped get the men together.
Did you know that Joe wrote that as a saxophone exercise?
